title: Another slice of bread and butter: three, four: right. She didn’t like her plate full. Right. He turned from the tray, lifted the kettle off the hob and set it sideways on the fire. It sat there, dull and squat, its spout stuck out. Cup of tea soon. Good. Mouth dry.
html_source: An introduction to the stream of consciousness through which Bloom creates his reality – similar techniques were used by other writers like Woolf later, but it is resolutely unpretentious in Ulysses, picking up the humdrum thoughts of Bloom as he prepares breakfast.
